item.title: Maryland’s Andre Mills is lone bright spot in 78-74 loss at Northwestern | TAKEAWAYS

item.title: Navy men’s basketball routs Lehigh, 72-49, to capture Patriot League title
item.description: Senior point guard Austin Benigni scored 19 of his game-high 25 points in the second half as Navy dominated on both ends of the court.

item.title: Navy beats Lehigh men’s basketball for regular season championship | PHOTOS
item.description: The Navy Midshipmen defeated the Lehigh Mountain Hawks, 72-49, to become the Patriot League Regular Season Champions in men’s NCAA basketball.

item.title: Chesapeake cheerleading wins 20th state title: ‘We wanted to end with a bang’

item.title: Anne Arundel school board passes $1.92B budget amid conflict on extracurricular funding
item.description: District 5’s Dana Schallheim, the longest-serving board member, voted against the budget recommendation “because of what I see as glaring inequities."

item.title: Mark Bedell reappointed as superintendent by Anne Arundel school board
item.description: Pending contract negotiations and final approval by the Maryland state superintendent, as required by law, Bedell’s second term will run through July 2030.
